# Tg-IDE-bot — project wiki

Synthesised memory. The context window is RAM; this folder is disk. **Search is `grep` and
`read` over `docs/`** — there is no index to build and no service to run.

**Stack:** Python 3.14 · python-telegram-bot v20 (polling) · aiohttp on `:8080` · mss,
pyautogui, pygetwindow, psutil · pytest
**Run:** `python bot.py` · **Test:** `python -m pytest tests/ -q` — the full runbook is
[environment.md](environment.md).

<!-- counts:begin -->
**16 decisions** · 3 assumptions · 2 blockers · **7 open rows** · **2 sessions, 2 chunks**
*Regenerated by `wiki-doctor.py --fix` — do not edit by hand.*

## Before you touch anything — the preflight

Four checks, under a minute. Each one exists because skipping it has cost somebody a day.

1. **`git status`.** The working tree can be ahead of this wiki — it is right now, and it
   has been for most of this project's life. `CLAUDE.md` is gitignored and the wiki was
   untracked until `D-001`, so "not in git" has never meant "not built".
2. **The board.** [ROADMAP.md](ROADMAP.md) — is anything `▶`? If so, somebody is on it;
   pick a different row or name your lane.
3. **The last two chunks.** [sessions/README.md](sessions/README.md), newest first. They say
   what the previous session left on the floor, which this file's summaries will not.
4. **The open questions.** The `B-` section of [DECISIONS.md](DECISIONS.md) — you may be
   about to spend a day on something that is blocked for a reason somebody already found.

**And one that is specific to this project:** before touching a feature, read its chunk in
[chunks/features/](chunks/features/). Those files are older than this wiki and they carry
the failure history — the paste key, the bracketed-paste race, the VPN hairpin. Skipping
them is how a fixed bug comes back.

## Update regulation (mandatory)

**Step 0 before you start; steps 1–6 after every feature or iteration.** Not optional:
without it the wiki goes stale and stops being worth reading, and a wiki nobody trusts is
worse than no wiki, because people act on it anyway.

0. **Status, before the first edit.** Set the row you are about to work on in
   [ROADMAP.md](ROADMAP.md) to `▶`. One row at a time. When you stop, set the status that is
   *true* — `✅` finished and verifiable, `⏸` **with what remains and where it is** — and
   never back to `☐`.
1. **Session chunk.** Write `sessions/NN-slug/YYYY-MM-DD-topic.md`: *what was done, how it
   works, what was decided and why*, and a **Next** block. One chunk per feature or
   iteration. `python tools/wiki/new-session.py "topic"` claims the number without racing
   another agent and writes the index rows for you.
2. **Synthesis into the documents.** Update whatever the change touched:
   [code-map.md](code-map.md) for new or moved paths, the feature's file in
   [chunks/features/](chunks/features/) for how it behaves, and the ledger for anything
   decided. **A new decision, assumption or blocker is a new numbered entry** in
   [DECISIONS.md](DECISIONS.md) — you supersede an old entry, you never rewrite it.
3. **Environment.** Did a version, a path, a port, a command or a procedure change? Did you
   hit a failure mode nobody had written down? Then [environment.md](environment.md).
   **This is the step that rots silently:** the code tells you when it is wrong, the
   environment does not.
4. **Indexes, then the checkers.** A row in the [session table](#sessions) and, for a new
   concept, a row in [concept → where to look](#concept--where-to-look). Then:
   ```bash
   python tools/wiki/check-links.py && python tools/wiki/wiki-doctor.py
   ```
5. **Local tool memory.** If a fact matters *between* sessions, put a short **pointer** in
   your own tool's memory — never a copy of this wiki. Copies drift; the wiki is canonical.
6. **The commit — only on "Current branch" or "New branch".** This project does not commit
   on its own initiative; see [../.claude/rules/git-protocol.md](../.claude/rules/git-protocol.md)
   for the two procedures and the message format. Version and changelog wait for
   "Let's finish".

Decisions, assumptions and blockers are addressable — `D-nnn`, `A-nnn`, `B-n`. **Cite the
id; do not restate the content.**

## Document map

Every document has exactly one job. A fact lives in one place; everything else cites it.

| Document | Owns | Never carries |
|---|---|---|
| [README.md](README.md) *(this file)* | the way in — the regulation, the maps, the session table | anything that belongs in a document below |
| [code-map.md](code-map.md) | **where things are** — every path and what it is for | why, or what is planned |
| [DECISIONS.md](DECISIONS.md) | **why** — numbered, append-only, cited by id | narrative, status |
| [ROADMAP.md](ROADMAP.md) | **what, in what order, and where it stands** | the content of the work |
| [environment.md](environment.md) | **the machine and the procedures** — versions, ports, commands, failure modes | anything that binds the code |
| [sessions/](sessions/README.md) | **what actually happened**, dated | anything forward-looking |
| [chunks/features/](chunks/features/) | **how one feature behaves**, deeply — the pre-wiki layer, still canonical for behaviour | the project's overall state |
| [changelog.md](changelog.md) | the released history, version by version | anything unreleased |
| [documentation/](documentation/) | imported and long-form research that is not ours to summarise | decisions |
| [analysis/](analysis/) · [design-system/](design-system/README.md) | the original plan, and the visual handoff | current behaviour |

When the two layers disagree: a **chunk wins about what happened**, a **synthesis document
wins about how things are now**.

**This file has a budget: 200 lines.** Over it, `wiki-doctor.py` fails.

## Concept → where to look

Phrased as the question a reader actually arrives with.

| I want to understand… | Look at |
|---|---|
| How to run it, and what breaks when I do | [environment.md](environment.md) |
| Where a given piece of behaviour lives | [code-map.md](code-map.md) |
| Why it was built this way and not the obvious way | [DECISIONS.md](DECISIONS.md) |
| What is being worked on right now | [ROADMAP.md](ROADMAP.md) — the `▶` rows |
| **Why my text never arrived in the terminal** | `D-005`–`D-008`, then [chunks/features/phase2-screen-input.md](chunks/features/phase2-screen-input.md) |
| Why the Mini App is slow on the phone but fine on the PC | `D-011`, `A-002`, [chunks/features/web-dashboard.md](chunks/features/web-dashboard.md) |
| Why `/refine` cannot type into the PC, and how that is enforced | `D-010`, [chunks/features/refinement-view.md](chunks/features/refinement-view.md) |
| What the tunnel is and what to do when it 502s | [environment.md](environment.md), then [documentation/README-vps.md](documentation/README-vps.md) |
| How a session gets continued after a rate-limit reset | [chunks/features/scheduled-messages.md](chunks/features/scheduled-messages.md) |
| What the buttons on the dashboard do | [chunks/features/web-dashboard.md](chunks/features/web-dashboard.md), [chunks/features/panel.md](chunks/features/panel.md) |
